title: Illumina DNA Prep - Clean Up Libraries
author: Opentrons
materials: Download your protocol and unzip if needed.

steps.title: Enter protocol parameters
steps.instruction: Input the required protocol parameters in the provided fields.

steps.title: Download and unzip protocol
steps.instruction: Download the protocol package and unzip it if needed.

steps.title: Upload custom labware
steps.instruction: In the OT App, go to More → Custom Labware → Add Labware and upload your .json labware files if required.

steps.title: Upload protocol file
steps.instruction: Upload the .py protocol file to the OT App on the Protocol tab.

steps.title: Set up deck layout
steps.instruction: Arrange the deck according to the provided deck map.

steps.title: Calibrate labware and pipette
steps.instruction: Calibrate all labware, tip racks, and the pipette using the OT App calibration workflow.

steps.title: Start the run
steps.instruction: Press “Run” in the OT App to execute the protocol.
